gielerak1986.abstract_paraphrase: Studies the DLR equation for two-dimensional trigonometric interactions; proves a uniqueness theorem extending Albeverio-Hoegh-Krohn CMP68(1979); uses Ginibre-type correlation inequalities to reduce uniqueness of translation-invariant regular tempered Gibbs states to independence of the infinite-volume free energy from boundary conditions, and proves that independence.
